**Your Blackboard host**
The domain of your institution's Blackboard (e.g. `learn.example.edu`). Glaze runs on any
`https://*/ultra/*` host, and different institutions run different Ultra versions, so this is usually
the first thing needed to reproduce a problem.

**Where in Ultra?**
The page or panel — course content, grades, calendar, the popup itself, etc.
